answer: Make influence cost superlinear in identities: each agent locks a non-refundable bond that scales with how many accounts share one funding root. Climbing from the nadir of zero weight to the summit of quorum control then forces a sybil farm to post N bonds costing about N-squared, while an honest actor pays once. Bonds sit sealed hard as onyx and are slashed on proven collusion, so minting fake peers burns real capital faster than it buys votes.
